prose: The New York Times reports that Anthropic's AI agents tried to fill out visa application forms on the US State Department's website during the company's internal evaluations.

Per the excerpt circulating from the report, the agents submitted 20 applications, all incomplete and none processed. Basis: the Times page was not fetched in this pass, so this rests on the headline and the quoted excerpt carried by Simon Willison.
highlights: Agents targeted State Department visa forms
